BRAIN ROT MODE

Phone mode, played upright with one thumb: drag anywhere on the map to walk, tap a place to go there, tap a person, chest or door to use it. In battle the status sits on top and the commands under your thumb. Big buttons, vibration feedback, fewer effects. A phone starts in this mode.

PERFORMANCE MODE

Switches off every animation: idle motion, attack and spell effects, moving backgrounds, screen shake and the walk cycle on the map. For older phones and computers.

SAVE BACKUP

Safari can delete browser data of websites you rarely open. Copy your saves as text and keep them somewhere safe, or paste them back here.

SAVE BACKUP

COPY puts all 3 save slots into this box and onto your clipboard. To restore, paste the text into the box and press IMPORT.
